comment: Hefesto's callgrind instructions per extraction workload (op minus base, bench/extract/extract_bench.py on the gds-bench all-cells block) on the x86_64 runner, GCC 14 Release with -g -fno-omit-frame-pointer. bench/extract/extract_gate.py gates each workload at or below Magic's count until its baseline is recorded here, then at the baseline + 2 % (m7-extraction design D23, Open Question 5 (a)). A workload is recorded only when it is at or below Magic's count (extract_gate.py --record). Entry: {"instructions": N, "magic": <Magic's count>, "run": <Performance run id>, "commit": <sha>}.
